question: What must we do with our hands before eating food? 🍽️
explanation: Awesome! Washing hands with soap removes germs and keeps our tummy healthy! 🧼
hint: We use water and soap for this.

question: What do we use to clean our teeth? 🦷
explanation: Great job! A toothbrush helps remove tiny food bits from our teeth! 🪥

question: How many times should we brush our teeth in a day? ☀️🌙
explanation: Super! We must brush once in the morning and once before bed! 2️⃣

question: What helps to wash away dirt from our body? 🚿
explanation: Awesome! Soap and water clean our body and make us smell fresh! 🧼

question: What should we do after playing outside in the mud? ⚽
explanation: Great job! A nice warm bath washes away all the mud and germs! 🛁
hint: It involves water and a towel.

question: How should we keep our fingernails? 💅
explanation: Super! Short and clean nails keep harmful germs away from our food! ✨

question: What is the right tool to trim our nails? ✂️
explanation: Awesome! A nail clipper safely cuts our nails to keep them neat! ✂️
hint: Parents help us use this small tool.

question: What should we do to keep our hair neat? 💇
explanation: Great job! Combing our hair every day makes us look smart and tidy! 🪮
hint: We use a comb or brush.

question: What should we wear after taking a fresh bath? 👕
explanation: Super! Wearing clean clothes keeps us healthy and smelling very good! ✨

question: What is the best time to go to sleep? ⏰
explanation: Awesome! Going to bed early gives our body plenty of rest! 🌙

question: Why do we play outdoor games? 🏏
explanation: Great job! Playing games outside makes our muscles strong and fit! 🏃
hint: It makes us run and jump.

question: What should we use when we sneeze? 🤧
explanation: Super! A handkerchief stops germs from flying into the air! 🤧
hint: It is a small piece of cloth.

question: What is the best drink when we are thirsty? 💧
explanation: Awesome! Clean water is the healthiest drink for our body! 🚰
hint: It has no color or taste.

question: How should we sit on our chairs? 🪑
explanation: Great job! A straight back keeps our spine healthy and strong! 📏

question: What magically removes unseen germs from our hands? ✨
explanation: Super! Soap bubbles trap the germs and wash them away! 🧼
hint: You make these when you rub your hands.

question: When is it very important to wash our hands? 🚻
explanation: Awesome! We must always wash hands after using the toilet to remove germs! 🚽

question: What gives our tired body the best rest? 🛌
explanation: Great job! A good night of sleep helps our body relax and grow! 😴
hint: We do this in our beds.

question: What keeps our teeth strong and shiny? 😁
explanation: Super! Brushing daily protects our teeth from cavities and pain! 🪥
hint: It gives us a bright smile.

question: What is a good habit before going to bed? 🌙
explanation: Awesome! Brushing at night cleans food bits so bugs don't hurt our teeth! 🪥
hint: We do this in the bathroom.

question: What do we use to dry our body after a bath? 🚿
explanation: Great job! A clean towel nicely wipes away all the wet water! 🧖
hint: It is soft and absorbs water.

question: What makes us smell fresh and nice all day? 🌸
explanation: Super! Bathing every morning keeps us smelling like fresh flowers! 🛁

question: What is a very good morning habit? 🌅
explanation: Awesome! Waking up early gives us plenty of time to get ready happily! ⏰

question: What is the best way to make muscles strong? 💪
explanation: Great job! Exercise keeps our body moving and makes our bones strong! 🏃

question: What must we do after petting a cute dog? 🐶
explanation: Super! Animals can carry germs, so we must wash our hands after touching them! 🧼

question: How should we eat our healthy food? 🥗
explanation: Awesome! Chewing food slowly helps our tummy digest it easily! 😋

question: What helps us grow tall and strong? 📏
explanation: Great job! Fruits, vegetables, and milk are healthy foods that help us grow! 🍎
hint: Things our parents cook for us.

question: Which of these makes us sweat and keeps us healthy? 💦
explanation: Super! Running makes our heart beat fast and keeps us very fit! 🏃

question: What should we do with our dirty clothes? 👕
explanation: Awesome! Washing clothes removes dust and makes them ready to wear again! 🧼
hint: Put them in the washing machine.

question: How can we keep our eyes safe and clean? 👀
explanation: Great job! Splashing cold water keeps our eyes fresh and clean! 💧
hint: Do it gently at the sink.

question: What helps to keep our hair healthy and soft? 💆
explanation: Super! Applying hair oil regularly gives our hair a nice shine! 🧴
hint: A smooth liquid in a bottle.

question: What must we do to fresh fruits before eating them? 🍎
explanation: Awesome! Washing fruits cleans away all the dirt from the farm! 💧

question: Where should we always throw our waste paper? 📝
explanation: Great job! Using a dustbin keeps our home and school neat and clean! 🗑️
hint: It is a small basket for trash.

question: How do we feel after splashing cold water on our face? 😌
explanation: Super! Cold water wakes up our sleepy eyes in the morning! ✨

question: What is very good for our body and mind? 🧘
explanation: Awesome! Yoga involves stretching and breathing, making us calm and strong! 🧘

question: What should we do right after coming home from outside? 🏠
explanation: Great job! Washing our face and hands removes the outside dust! 🧼

question: Why does our body need sleep every night? 🌙
explanation: Super! Sleep recharges our body so we can play happily the next day! ⚡

question: What does daily bathing remove from our skin? 🚿
explanation: Awesome! Bathing scrubs away the sweaty dirt so we don't get sick! 🦠
hint: The dark stuff you see when you play in mud.

question: What keeps the doctor away? 👩‍⚕️
explanation: Great job! Healthy habits like cleanliness and good food keep illnesses away! 🌟

question: What do clean and healthy children do? 😁
explanation: Super! Healthy children have lots of energy to smile and play games! 🎈

question: How can we keep our feet clean and safe outside? 👣
explanation: Awesome! Shoes protect our feet from sharp stones and dirty mud! 👟

question: What do we put on our toothbrush to clean our teeth? 🪥
explanation: Great job! Minty toothpaste fights the bad germs in our mouth! 🧼

question: When should we ideally trim our nails? ✂️
explanation: Super! Nails grow fast, so trimming them every week keeps them clean! 📅

question: What should we do when we cough? 😷
explanation: Awesome! Covering our mouth stops the cough germs from spreading to others! 🤧
hint: Use a tissue or your elbow.

question: What healthy drink makes our bones very strong? 🦴
explanation: Great job! Milk is full of calcium which makes our bones solid and strong! 🥛

question: What must we do to the toilet after using it? 🚽
explanation: Super! Flushing the toilet keeps the bathroom clean and free of bad smells! 🌊

question: Which of these is a great morning activity? 🌞
explanation: Awesome! Stretching wakes up all our muscles so we feel ready for the day! 🧘

question: What happens when we stay clean and fit? ✨
explanation: Great job! A clean body and a fit mind make us the happiest children! 😊

question: How should our school uniform look every day? 🏫
explanation: Super! Wearing a neat uniform shows we are good and disciplined students! ✨

question: What keeps our mouth fresh after eating food? 👄
explanation: Awesome! Rinsing our mouth with water washes away the sticky food bits! 💧

question: What does keeping our surroundings clean do? 🏡
explanation: Great job! A clean home has no place for harmful germs to hide! 🛡️
hint: Using a broom helps with this.
